profile.title: LumenBox Bridge
profile.description: Ported from the Grok Bot "LumenBox Bridge". See its skills for what it does.

memory.text: LumenBox (github.com/fakechris/lumenbox) is the person's own agent team on their laptop; it can drive this box as an attached box over their Tailscale network, on desktop :10 and port 13370, without touching the host bot's own desktops :1-:9.
The bridge installer is ~/.lumen/bin/lumen-bridge.sh (check / tailscale / install / start / status / token / connect-hint); every subcommand is safe to run again.

routines.name: lumenbox-bridge-keepalive
routines.description: Every hour, make sure the LumenBox daemon on this box is running; say something only when it had to be restarted or could not be. (routine; starts paused until its placeholders are filled)

files.SKILL.md:
---
name: lumenbox-bridge-keepalive
description: >-
  Every hour, make sure the LumenBox daemon on this box is running; say something only when it had to be restarted or could not be.
schedule: 50 * * * *
timezone: {timezone}
paused: true
---
Run `~/.lumen/bin/lumen-bridge.sh status`. If it reports the daemon up, do nothing and say nothing. Otherwise run `~/.lumen/bin/lumen-bridge.sh start`; if that prints a `BOXD_URL` line, tell the person in one line that the LumenBox bridge was restarted after the box came back; if it fails, send them the last lines of its output.

Fires on: every hour.

Fires on:
- cron `50 * * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
